title_zh: People and places — 第9节可背诵讲义
body_en: People and places shape each other. A busy market feels loud and bright. A library feels quiet and safe. Ask who works there and what they care about. Draw a simple map of your street and mark three helpful places. Kind words make any place nicer.
body_zh: 人与地方彼此塑造。热闹的市场又吵又亮；图书馆安静又安全。问问谁在那里工作、他们在意什么。画一张你家街道的简图，标出三个有用的地方。友善的话让任何地方都更美好。
